description: This file contains helper functions implementing experimental and internal functionality for named tensors in PyTorch, including name resolution, serialization checks, and tensor dimension renaming.

methods.name: check_serializing_named_tensor
methods.description: Checks if a tensor with names supports serialization; raises error if named tensors are not supported for serialization.

methods.name: build_dim_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping from dimension names or indices to names for a tensor.

methods.name: unzip_namedshape
methods.description: Unzips a named shape structure into separate sequences, validating input type.

methods.name: namer_api_name
methods.description: Returns the appropriate rename function name ('rename' or 'rename_') based on in-place flag.

methods.name: is_ellipsis
methods.description: Checks if an item is an ellipsis ('...' or Ellipsis).

methods.name: single_ellipsis_index
methods.description: Finds the index of a single ellipsis in a list of names, raises error if more than one.

methods.name: expand_single_ellipsis
methods.description: Expands an ellipsis to a list of names based on pre- and post-globbing counts.

methods.name: replace_ellipsis_by_position
methods.description: Replaces an ellipsis in names with expanded names from tensor.

methods.name: resolve_ellipsis
methods.description: Expands ellipsis in names to match tensor's names.

methods.name: update_names_with_list
methods.description: Updates tensor names with a list, resolving ellipsis if present.

methods.name: update_names_with_mapping
methods.description: Updates tensor names based on a rename mapping.

methods.name: update_names
methods.description: Main function to update tensor names either via list or mapping, supporting in-place renaming.
